notes.s: He hates her and needs her, and cannot work out which one is worse.
notes.t: Lead single from 화양연화 pt.1 in April 2015, and the pivot in the group's sound away from school-trilogy hip-hop toward something closer to pop. It gave them their first real chart win at home and the first video people built theories around for years, later extended into the longer cut with the fire and the hospital. The writing swings from insult to plea inside one breath, and ARMY treats the line about loving alone and breaking up alone as the one that did the damage.
k: 안대 is a blindfold, and it sounds exactly like the 안 돼 that ends the line before it, and like a clipped reported-speech 안 대. The primary reading is that everything she said is a blindfold, which the next line confirms by saying it covers the truth, since covering is what a blindfold does. Fan translations tend to pick one reading and lose the chain.

찢다 is to tear and 찍다 is to stab or stamp, one vowel apart, and the run keeps going into 다 싫어. Korean rap gets a lot of its drive from minimal pairs like this. Hearing them as one set rather than four separate complaints is most of what makes the verse land.

뭣 is a swerve. 뭣 같다 stands in for a word that would not survive a radio edit, and it means roughly this is garbage. Korean lyrics dodge censors this way all the time, so when a vague 뭣 or 거 turns up in a hostile line, assume the rude version was meant.

하필 means of all the possible ones, and it only ever shows up when the speaker resents the answer. So this is not asking why you, it is complaining that it had to be you. Drop it into any question where you want that sting.

vocab.note: Intransitive, it happens to you; 망가뜨리다 is to wreck something yourself
Stiff and formal, the register of a public notice, which is what makes it cutting here
Describes how someone strikes you, so 네가 밉다 is you are hateful to me, not I hate you
Literally to go out like a flame; as a command it is a real insult, not banter
More literary than 헤어지다, which is what people say
Works for temperature and for personality, same as English
Soft enough to be affectionate between couples
The 마음 and 가슴 in the same line are the feeling heart; 심장 is the pump
The warmth and slant of it, where 햇빛 is just the light

vocab.en: of all things, of all people

vocab.note: Picks the lesser of two bad options: I would rather this than that
